_what: Hand Hygiene and Associated Products and Services -- every lot-source supplier name on the framework's Find a Tender award notice that reaches no NHS Supply Chain brief row, and what was decided about it. Written by scripts/_add_hand_hygiene_clinical_records_1117.py so the 'out' decisions are recorded once and not re-worked.
framework: Hand Hygiene and Associated Products and Services
ruling: Lou, 17/11/2026 (Needs-Lou N886): "Hand hygiene yes, the others no", refined to "depends on the product as hand hygiene could be classed as clinical". Catering, facilities/electrical, furniture, office-supply and food names stay out entirely.

included.name: Esteve Pharmaceuticals Ltd
included.why: Licensed leave-on emollient (Aquamax) indicated for eczema and psoriasis, in the NHS dm+d, from a prescription pharmaceutical company. Clinical skin care, not a washroom consumable.

included.name: GOJO Industries Europe Ltd
included.why: PURELL Advanced is certified to EN 12791, the surgical hand-rub standard, and the Hub already holds this company as GOJO / Purell. The award spelling was added there as an alias; no second record was created. The UK entity is in liquidation and is not on NHS Supply Chain's current supplier list -- both stated on the record's own alert.

excluded.name: Aqualution System Ltd
excluded.why: Hypochlorous acid manufacturer. Its own brands, read on aqualution.co.uk on 17/11/2026, are Salvesan (surface disinfectant), Solosan (animal first aid), Agripure (agriculture and food processing) and Within Skincare (cosmetic-grade). The medical offer is a private-label CATEGORY with no named clinical product, a bare "CE-marked" claim with no device class, and no stated NHS or hospital use beyond "Hospital & Clinic Sanitation -- surface disinfection". Genuinely borderline under Lou's "depends on the product" ruling, so left out: a record asserting a clinical range the company does not itself name would be worse than no record. Revisit only if Aqualution publishes a named clinical product with a device class. Company number 04100816 is published on its own site and matches the register, so identity is not the blocker here -- the product is.

excluded.name: INEOS ENTERPRISES GROUP LIMITED
excluded.why: Companies House 04687714, previously INEOS CHLOR GROUP LIMITED, Bankes Lane Office, Runcorn -- a chlor-chemicals group entity, not a medical supplier. INEOS's own site describes INEOS Hygienics as "a successful household and personal care brand" in FMCG, established in response to the pandemic, and names no clinical product (read 17/11/2026). General-purpose and consumer sanitiser is the side of Lou's line that stays out.

excluded.name: Zoono Holdings Ltd
excluded.why: Companies House 11027188. Its own site (zoono.com, which redirects to zoono.co.nz, read 17/11/2026) sells alcohol-free sanitiser, body and surface wipes, a foot spray, a mould defence system and room deodorisers, with a surface-bonding antimicrobial molecule as the pitch. No clinical product, no medical device registration. Surface and consumer antimicrobial, not clinical.

excluded.name: QYK BRANDS LLC
excluded.why: A US LLC. No UK registration is expected and none was found on 17/11/2026, so the identity cannot be settled at the bar data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json sets, and the notice gives no number. Its product is general-purpose hand sanitiser, so it would fail the clinical test even with the identity settled. Out on both counts.

excluded.name: SpectrumX
excluded.why: A bare trading word with no legal form, and the notice gives no number. Companies House on 17/11/2026 carries at least seven distinct companies using it: SPECTRUMX HEALTHCARE LIMITED (12622911, Liquidation), SPECTRUMX HOLDINGS LIMITED (13039699, Liquidation), SPECTRUMX MEDICAL LIMITED (13042763), SPECTRUMX DIRECT LIMITED (13042692), SPECTRUMX HOLDINGS UK LTD (13745475), plus SPECTRUMX LIMITED (09589769) and SPECTRUMX UK LIMITED (10900106), both dissolved. Which of them holds Lot 2 cannot be settled from the notice. A shared name is not evidence: identity first, record after. Must not be confused with the Hub's existing BioSpectrum Ltd, Spectrum Medical Limited or Vision Pharmaceuticals Ltd T/A Spectrum records -- different companies.

excluded.name: J A Marketing limited
excluded.why: Both Companies House candidates on 17/11/2026 are DISSOLVED: J A MARKETING LIMITED 04313818 (Ground Floor Offices, Riverside Mills, Elland, West Yorkshire, dissolved 01/08/2025) and J A MARKETING LIMITED 17156425 (Lincoln, dissolved 22/09/2026 and incorporated in 2025, after the January 2023 award, so it cannot be the awardee). No product evidence exists for the name anywhere -- no company site, no NHS Supply Chain catalogue entry, no dm+d listing. There is nothing to write a record from, clinical or otherwise.

residual: With these two resolved, six of the framework's eight unresolved lot-source names stay unresolved on purpose. Separately: NHS Supply Chain's brief lists 21 suppliers where the award notice named 33, and the brief's stated count matches its printed list, so the difference is real and not a short capture. That is why these names have no brief row to attach a lot to, and it belongs to the '48 names not on this brief' job, not to this one.
